name: TOKAI Holdings Corporation
summary: TOKAI Holdings Corporation engages in energy, information and communications, and related businesses in Japan and internationally. The company supplies liquefied petroleum gas for individuals, automotive, and corporations; solar power, and other high-pressure gases; and provides electricity to individuals and corporations, information and communications services to individual and corporate customers, including optical internet connection, mobile services, data center, corporate communication, and system development services; CATV services, such as broadcasting and communication services.
